prompt: A luxury watch brand is setting the price for a new limited-edition model. The candidate's framework: (1) What collectors would pay for scarcity; (2) Prices of comparable limited editions; (3) Production cost of the model; (4) The cost of the brand's office lease. What is the flaw in this framework?

options.text: Buckets 1 and 2 overlap and should be merged
options.feedback: Willingness to pay and comparable prices are different inputs.
Right. Replace it with the effect on the brand: the price must protect the brand's luxury positioning.

options.text: It is a generic pricing framework
options.feedback: The buckets fit luxury pricing. The flaw is bucket 4.

explanation: Luxury pricing balances collector value, comparables, cost and brand positioning. Office rent is overhead with no link to this price.

extras.corrected_framework: Collector willingness to pay; comparable editions; production cost; brand positioning
